archetype: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) with Heritage Organic twists

design_philosophy.vibe: Classic, heritage, formal, ceremonial. Evokes a wood-paneled committee room at a heritage cricket pavilion (like Lord's or Eden Gardens).
core_principles: No generic SaaS aesthetics. No 'AI slop' gradients or neon.
Embrace heritage cricket motifs: scoreboard typography layout, willow grain textures, brass/gold details, ivory paper backgrounds, deep pitch green and oxblood accents.
Typography hierarchy must evoke a printed annual report or formal club bulletin.
Animations must be slow, dignified, and ceremonial, rather than snappy or bouncy.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight font-medium text-mpca-green-dark
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight font-medium text-mpca-green-dark
rules.overlines: text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-mpca-brass

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. The bento grids should have wider gaps, and sections should have 'breathing room' fitting of a luxury/heritage context.
spacing_and_layout.gap_strategy: gap-8 md:gap-12 for bento grid, gap-6 for dashboard metrics
spacing_and_layout.borders: Use strict structural borders (1px solid) to create a 'bulletin/register' look rather than floating soft shadows.
spacing_and_layout.radii: Use minimal rounding. rounded-none or rounded-sm for formal document feel. Buttons can be rounded-none or rounded.

cards.dashboard_stats: Flat background (mpca-ivory), 1px subtle brass/gold border (border-[#C5A059]/30), no soft shadows. Sharp corners or rounded-sm.
cards.persona_cards: Wood-paneled or Pitch Green textured backgrounds. High contrast serif text for the roles (President, Secretary, etc.), mimicking a blazer pocket or formal nameplate.
cards.member_register: Table layout with strict horizontal rules, reminiscent of a printed ledger. Row hover should just be a subtle background tint (mpca-parchment).

buttons.primary: bg-mpca-green-dark text-on-dark border border-transparent hover:bg-mpca-green hover:border-mpca-brass transition-all duration-300 font-sans tracking-wide uppercase text-sm px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-mpca-green-dark border border-mpca-brass hover:bg-mpca-parchment transition-all duration-300 font-sans tracking-wide uppercase text-sm px-6 py-3

forms.inputs: bg-mpca-ivory border-b border-mpca-gray/30 rounded-none focus:border-mpca-brass focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none px-0 py-2 (Underlined style, like a physical form).
forms.labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-mpca-gray-dark mb-1 font-semibold

navigation.sidebar: Deep pitch green background (bg-mpca-green-dark) with gold/brass icons and text (text-mpca-gold-light/70 hover:text-mpca-gold-light). Sidebar sections for 'Phase 2/3/4' should be visibly disabled/greyed out with opacity-40.
navigation.header: Solid mpca-ivory background, bottom border in subtle brass. Sticky. Z-50.

surfaces_and_textures.overlays: Never use solid black overlays. Use bg-mpca-green-dark/70 for dark overlays on hero images to keep the green/heritage tint.
surfaces_and_textures.patterns: Use generated textures for specific high-end areas (e.g. login cards, hero section). Use CSS variables for subtle paper grain on the main app background.

usage_instructions.hero_cricket_ground: Use as the background for the Landing page hero section. Overlay with bg-mpca-green-dark/80 for text contrast.
usage_instructions.pitch_green_texture: Use for the background of the Demo login persona cards, particularly for executive roles like President or Secretary.
usage_instructions.willow_wood_texture: Use for accent sidebars, call-out banners, or the Committee Member persona card.
usage_instructions.vintage_scoreboard: Use for the Dashboard stats/metrics area background, overlaid with high opacity ivory/green so numbers pop out.
usage_instructions.vintage_bat_ball: Use as a supporting image in the Public Disclosures or About section.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use slow, deliberate transitions. transition-all duration-500 ease-in-out.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-0.5) with a brass border highlight. Do not use heavy bouncy effects.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use a slow fade or a stately sliding animation. No rapid spinners.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over wood/pitch green textures has sufficient contrast, using text-mpca-ivory or text-mpca-gold-light.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-president-card').

icons.style: Use thin stroke weights (strokeWidth={1.5}) to match the formal, elegant feel of the serif typography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the google_fonts_url into the index.html or main stylesheet.
Configure Tailwind with the custom colors provided (mpca-green-dark, mpca-ivory, mpca-brass, etc.) and map them to standard classes if using Shadcn.
Use Bricolage Grotesque as the default sans (for body, buttons, tags) and Cormorant Garamond for ALL headings.
Do NOT use standard rounded cards. Enforce `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` heavily.
For the Demo login screen, create a visually striking grid of cards using the textures provided, each representing a persona (President, Hon. Secretary, Treasurer, Committee Member, Member, Public).
For the Membership Register, build a clean, ledger-style table rather than modern SaaS cards.
For Phase 2-5 features in the sidebar, ensure they are rendered but visually disabled (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed) to show the full scope of the ERP.
Ensure the layout feels like a stately, wood-paneled digital document—a love letter to cricket heritage.
